caveats.table_caption: Count/time columns represent method-native computational stages and are not mathematically identical across methods. Total wall time is the common performance quantity.
caveats.olhoff: Du-Olhoff timings and iteration counts refer to the frozen reconstruction used in this study. Some continuation and inner-solver details are not uniquely specified by the original publication; therefore these values should be interpreted as representative measurements of this reconstruction rather than exact historical implementation timings.
caveats.olhoff_label: The Olhoff column is labelled "Du-Olhoff reconstruction (M4)" and must not be labelled "Olhoff 2007".
caveats.memory: Reliable, method-independent peak-memory measurement was not available in the MATLAB environment; memory was omitted rather than reported with inconsistent semantics.
caveats.olhoff_iteration_counts: The outer iteration count of the Du-Olhoff reconstruction depends on a move-limit continuation schedule that the original publication does not specify. The frozen schedule used here is documented; a different admissible schedule changes the count without changing the physics.
caveats.scaling: Scaling exponents may be fitted only to complete campaign data and never to smoke or preflight runs. For the Du-Olhoff reconstruction the source audit records that its outer iteration count is an artifact of the continuation trigger, so a fitted exponent for that method describes this reconstruction, not the published method.

common.total_wall_time_s: Caller-side tic/toc around the solve and nothing else. CSV/JSON/MAT writing, plotting, table formatting, LaTeX generation, the common E1/E2/E3 evaluator and topology rendering are all outside it.
common.overhead_time_s: Whatever the solve spends outside the two named stages: configuration dispatch, model build, filter preparation, the final modal analysis and result assembly. It exists so that no microsecond has to be forced into a named stage.
common.timing_accounting_fail: TIMING_ACCOUNTING_FAIL: set when the residual exceeds the predeclared tolerance recorded alongside it.
common.independent_crosscheck_residual_s: A SECOND, independent measurement of the same interval: the caller-side total minus the solver's own self-reported wall time. Unlike the identity above it is not an algebraic tautology, so it detects a mis-nested timer.
common.memory: NOT MEASURED and NOT REPORTED. Reliable, method-independent peak-memory measurement was not available in the MATLAB environment; memory was omitted rather than reported with inconsistent semantics.

Proposed.architecture: one reference eigenanalysis, then a SIMP topology optimization

count1.name: eigenanalysis_solves
count1.meaning: The number of reference eigenanalyses performed. This is a SOLVE count. It is NOT an optimization iteration and must not be read as one.

time1.name: stage1_eigenanalysis_and_preparation_s
time1.boundary: solver initialization: mesh and element matrices, boundary conditions, filter preparation, and the single reference eigenanalysis. stage1_reference_eigen_time_s isolates the eigenanalysis alone and is a SUB-INTERVAL of this.

time2.name: stage2_time_s
time2.boundary: the Stage-2 loop only; disjoint from Stage 1.

DuOlhoffReconstructionM4.label: Du-Olhoff reconstruction (M4)
DuOlhoffReconstructionM4.architecture: NESTED: an outer loop, each of whose iterations contains a complete MMA sub-optimization.

count2.name: inner_mma_iterations_total
count2.meaning: cumulative nested MMA sub-iterations over the whole run.

time1.name: outer_time_excluding_inner_s
time1.boundary: every computational region of an outer iteration EXCEPT the nested MMA solve: FE assembly, the eigenproblem, modal processing, generalized-gradient sensitivities, sensitivity filtering, local subproblem construction, the step controller, the design update, bookkeeping and the convergence test. Measured as sum(t_outer) - sum(t_inner) from per-iteration timers, so the nested solve cannot be double-counted.

time2.name: inner_mma_time_total_s
time2.boundary: the nested MMA loop, and only that.

DuOlhoffReconstructionM4.prohibited: N_outer + N_inner must NEVER be reported as a generic iteration count: the two are different objects.
DuOlhoffReconstructionM4.caveat: Du-Olhoff timings and iteration counts refer to the frozen reconstruction used in this study. Some continuation and inner-solver details are not uniquely specified by the original publication; therefore these values should be interpreted as representative measurements of this reconstruction rather than exact historical implementation timings.
